name: project-sessions
description: One named background Claude Code session per git repo, named `<host>:<owner>/<repo>`. In attended sessions (or with PROJECT_SESSIONS_AUTO=1) the hooks create or resume it themselves, detached: SessionStart resumes a stopped one and names it, UserPromptSubmit adds one line per prompt and creates a missing one in the caller's permission mode. `project-session ensure` finds it in `claude agents --json --all` by name AND repo root and resumes only by bare full session id (the only form that does not start a copy). The main session hands work over with SendMessage. A second skill, project-shape, checks the repo is a valid Claude Code project.
